specs: Annual Nutcracker ballet production involving students from primary to advanced levels
Progressive curriculum from 18 months to advanced levels
Supportive, family-centered environment with experienced instructors

blurb: Offers dance classes from toddlers to advanced levels, including ballet, tap, and creative movement. Hosts annual performances such as The Nutcracker and Spring Performance. Provides private lessons and a progressive curriculum to develop technique, confidence, and artistry.
extraNote: Tuition is non-refundable and divided into nine monthly installments from September through May · 3% surcharge applies to credit and debit card payments; no charge for ACH/EFT · Missed classes due to illness or injury may be made up; no refunds for missed classes · Classes canceled due to inclement weather will be notified by email by 1 PM weekdays and 7:30 AM Saturdays · Costume fees due February 2027; $80 child size, $95 adult size per costume package
